sanskrit_verse:
अर्वाक् चतुर्दशादह्नो यस्य नो राजदैविकम् ।
व्यसनं जायते घोरं स शुद्धः स्यान्न संशयः ॥११३॥
transliteration: arvāk caturdaśād ahno yasya no rājadaivikam | vyasanaṃ jāyate ghoraṃ sa śuddhaḥ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||113||
sph_interpretive_translation: If within fourteen days a person suffers no calamity or divine displeasure manifesting as royal punishment, then that individual is purified without doubt.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The king's judgment aligns with cosmic law when unchallenged by adverse consequences.
Causation: Absence of calamity indicates absence of transgression in the eyes of dharma.
Capacity-based responsibility: Purity is restored automatically upon absence of manifested consequence.
Restoration logic: Consciousness purification occurs naturally when no external correction manifests.
Consciousness alignment: Divine silence confirms internal harmony and lawful conduct.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, where evidence of wrongdoing fails to manifest through natural or institutional consequences within the prescribed period, the accused shall be deemed purified. No further inquiry is required if the causal field remains undisturbed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that absence of consequence affirms truth. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows no sequential misalignment has occurred. Responsibility dissolves where effect is absent. Non-punitive reality affirms that purity arises spontaneously when error does not echo in action or outcome.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Acknowledge the passage of time without disturbance as completion of karmic inquiry.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reaffirm individual sovereignty under dharma when untouched by consequence.
Capacity Restoration: Reinstate full social and spiritual participation upon confirmation of alignment.
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate return to community roles based on absence of dissonance indicators.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure consciousness justice. There is no punishment—only spontaneous restoration. Reality itself judges. Consciousness prevails.
